sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fast-Casual Self-Serve Broth Bowl Master Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Panama (Sociedad Anónima regime under the Public Registry of Panama)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic heritage) with strong commercial-statutory regulation; unitary national system
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: China–Panama Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 17 November 2017; in force since 5 April 2018)?

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas, as comprehensively amended and consolidated by Ley 5 de 2016 (Ley General de Sociedades); applicable sections: Arts. 1-7 (formation, name, registered office, statutory purpose), Arts. 10-11 (authorized capital, shares), Art. 20 (board of directors), Art. 45 (officers); supplemented by the Public Registry Regulation (Reglamento del Registro Público).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social y Estatutos de la Sociedad Anónima (Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws), presented for inscription as an 'Escritura Pública' or certified private document, resulting in a 'Certificado de Inscripción y Registro de Sociedad Anónima'.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow/bank deposit requirement. The authorized capital must be at least USD 10,000, typically divided into 100 common shares with par value of USD 100.00, fully subscribed but payable at the directors' call.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board accept the subscription of 100 ordinary common shares, par value USD 100.00 each, being the full authorized capital, and that the registered office of the corporation be established at [street address], Panama City, Republic of Panama. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [name] be appointed President, [name] Secretary, and [name] Treasurer. Each officer shall execute all documents, contracts, permits and applications required for the company's licensed operations, including municipal operating permits and sanitary licenses. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the issuance of share certificates to subscribers be ratified; corporate books be opened; and this resolution take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas; electronic filing via 'Portal de Servicios en Línea' of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation request with up to three proposed corporate names ending in 'S.A.', each followed by the suffix 'de Panamá'. Pay the B/. 10.00 name-search fee online or at the registry cashier. Obtain the 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre' confirming that the proposed name is available and not confusingly similar to an existing registered entity.
required_dossiers: Completed Solicitud de Reserva de Nombre (name reservation form)
Government fee receipt (B/. 10.00)
Copy of the incorporator's passport or resident identity card
If represented, notarized power of attorney of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or the registry issues an observation, submit an amended reservation containing alternative names. A formal administrative objection may be filed within five business days; the registry will adjudicate priority and issue a definitive name clearance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría Pública) in Panama City or other Panamanian notarial district
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos in Spanish, including corporate name, statutory registered office, purpose, authorized capital, share classes, number and competencies of directors, and officers. The subscriber(s) execute the instrument before the notary, who authenticates signatures and issues certified copies for registration. If the incorporator is absent, a special power of attorney authorizing the notarial execution is required.
required_dossiers: Final draft of Pacto Social y Estatutos
Name clearance certificate issued by the Public Registry
Passport or identity documents of all incorporators and initial directors
Notarized power of attorney (if a proxy signs)
Sworn statement of lawful origin of capital, if requested by the notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or a subscriber identifies a discrepancy, the instrument is corrected by executing an addendum ('copia adicional') or by replacing the defective pages with the consent of all parties. The notarized document is then re-executed and certified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá - Sección de Registro de Personas Jurídicas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Pacto Social y Estatutos together with the applicable registration fee receipt (approximately USD 250.00) at the registry's filing window or via the authorized e-filing service. The registrar reviews the instrument for statutory compliance, approves the inscription, and issues the formal 'Certificado de Registro de la Sociedad Anónima'. Publication of the registration notice may be required where designated by law or by the parties' articles.
required_dossiers: Notarized original and two certified copies of the Pacto Social y Estatutos
Name clearance certificate
Proof of payment of registry fees (USD 250.00 base)
Copy of the notary's credentials and registration
If applicable, evidence that the first board of directors has accepted office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a 'requerimiento' (defect notice), the applicant must cure the defect within ten business days by filing an amendment, additional clause, or supplemental notarial document. If registration is denied, the company may file a 'recurso de reconsideración' with the registry and, thereafter, a judicial appeal before the tribunal for registros públicos.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Social Security Enrollment, and Municipal Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Caja de Seguro Social (CSS); Municipality of Panama - Dirección de Rentas y Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registry inscription, the corporation must obtain its RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) at DGI using the certificate of incorporation and registered office lease. Register the corporation as an employer with CSS, file the sworn declaration of activities, and open a corporate bank account. The municipality must issue an 'Aviso de Operación' before the premises commence commercial activities; this is part of the municipal licensing process for the planned self-serve restaurant.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro de la Sociedad Anónima
Certified copy of the Pacto Social y Estatutos
Lease or ownership title evidencing the registered physical premises
RUC application form (Solicitud de Registro Único de Contribuyente)
Employer registration form with CSS
Identification of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI queries the RUC application, provide corrected copies of the corporate documents and pay any outstanding registry duty; if the municipality observes deficiencies, rectify the premises documentation and submit a new Aviso application. Administrative appeals may be filed with the municipal tax directorate within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Convening the First Board of Directors and Opening Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered office of the corporation / Corporate Secretary and Notary, as required for counts and certifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the inaugural board meeting in person or by conference call, in accordance with the statutory quorum (majority of directors unless the bylaws require otherwise). The board approves share subscriptions, ratifies the registered office, appoints officers, authorizes issuance of share certificates, opens corporate books (Libro de Accionistas, Libro de Actas de Directorio, and Libro de Registro de Acciones), and approves the corporate bank account mandate.
required_dossiers: Notice or waiver of notice of the inaugural board meeting
Draft of the First Board Resolution
Share subscription list
Minutes book and share ledger
Statement of acceptance of office by each director and officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director challenges the meeting, reconvene with proper notice and verify quorum; record the challenge in the minutes and allow abstentions. All corporate books must be completed with original signatures and, where required by Panamanian law, stamped and legalized before the registry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) - Dirección General de Salud; Municipality of Panama - Department of Commercial Permits; jointly administer food-service licensing and operating permits
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Permiso Sanitario de Funcionamiento para Establecimientos de Alimentos y Bebidas (Sanitary Operating Permit for Food and Beverage Establishments) and Aviso de Operación Municipal (Municipal Operating Notice)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) - Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I (low-impact registration) - the self-serve restaurant operation qualifies for an 'Estudio de Impacto Ambiental Categoría I' or simplified environmental registration, requiring submission of a formal project description and environmental commitment declaration before operational licensing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to the municipal sewer must meet the Ministry of Health technical standards for non-industrial effluents, including pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 not exceeding 200 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 200 mg/L, and fats/ozone-removed grease not exceeding 20 mg/L, with mandatory grease-trap pretreatment for all kitchen drains; ventilation systems must control cooking odors and VOCs through hood-and-exhaust filtration; solid food waste must be segregated, stored in sealed containers, and removed by licensed municipal or private waste haulers; no hazardous or chlorinated solvents may be discharged into the municipal wastewater network
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate (Certificado de Prevención y Seguridad contra Incendios) issued by the Panamanian Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá); structural load approval and mechanical/electrical safety inspections by the Municipality of Panama; occupational health-and-safety clearance for commercial kitchen staff issued by the Ministry of Labor and Social Development (MITRADEL) under the national workplace risk-prevention regulations

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF) — electronic services portal: SID (Sistema Integrado de Gestión de Ingresos), https://www.dgi.gob.pa; SID hosts RUC registration, ITBMS and ISR e-filing, electronic invoicing clearance, and taxpayer account management.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) through a licensed resident agent and inscribe the corporation with the Registro Público (no minimum capital; non-resident shareholders/directors are permitted). 2) File the DGI registration application (Formulario de Inscripción) together with the public deed, certificate of incorporation, and a sworn ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) declaration; the DGI issues the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) with a check-digit verification number. 3) Obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación and any sanitary, food-safety, and MICI commercial licenses for the fast-casual restaurant and franchise head-office activities. 4) Activate the SID e-invoicing module and obtain the digital signature token (firma electrónica) for authorized representatives. 5) Register as an ITBMS taxpayer and as an employer with the Social Security Fund (CSS) for payroll withholding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama applies statutory territorial sourcing at the entity level (25% ISR on Panamanian-source net income only; no US-style check-the-box election). Available elections include: (a) the optional flat-tax regime under Article 699-A of the Fiscal Code (USD 200 per annum for inactive S.A.s with no Panamanian-source taxable activity) — NOT available to an operating franchise chain; (b) the Multinational Company Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007 for regional head-office services rendered to non-Panamanian affiliates; (c) special economic zone regimes (Panamá Pacífico, City of Knowledge) subject to physical relocation; (d) the simplified small-taxpayer ITBMS regime if annual gross revenue does not exceed USD 36,000 — not expected for this business model. Hybrid-mismatch elections are inapplicable; Panama adheres to OECD/G20 BEPS minimum standards.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS — Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (value-added transfer tax on movable goods and services), governed by Articles 1057–1086 of the Fiscal Code and Executive Decree No. 1 of 2005.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary de minimis threshold in USD: any person or entity habitually making taxable supplies of movable goods or rendering taxable services in Panamanian territory (including each local restaurant outlet and the licensor entity) must register for ITBMS before commencing activities; filing obligations are monthly through the SID portal.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica) under Executive Decree No. 52 of 30 October 2019 as implemented through successive DGI resolutions on the SID platform. Invoicing software (POS/ERP) must integrate with the DGI via HTTPS/API and submit XML/JSON invoice payloads for immediate validation and digital stamping; each approved invoice receives an alphanumeric FEPA folio and QR code before being delivered to the customer. The mandate was phased in from 2020 for large taxpayers and extended to all commercially active taxpayers (restaurants, franchise licensors, and service providers) in the 2023–2024 activation windows. Failure to clear an invoice in real time is treated as failure to issue a fiscal invoice.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods (e.g., food ingredients, spice blends, equipment, branded packaging) are zero-rated at 0% ITBMS when goods physically depart Panamanian territory under customs export control. Export services — including franchise rights, trademarks, proprietary Malatang know-how, and management or sub-licensing services rendered to non-resident franchisees — are zero-rated at 0% ITBMS where the licensed use or economic benefit occurs entirely outside Panama and the purchaser is domiciled abroad. The exporter must retain contemporaneous contractual and customs evidence that the goods left Panama or that the services were exclusively consumed extraterritorially.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera, DUA) validated by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA) for goods; for services, a DGI export declaration/export manifest together with the service agreement.
Bill of Lading (Conocimiento de Embarque) or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panama.
Inward Remittance Certificate (certificación bancaria de ingreso de divisas) evidencing receipt of foreign-origin USD proceeds into a Panamanian bank account.
Commercial invoice and zero-rated export invoice (Factura de Exportación) bearing the SID/FEPA electronic clearance stamp.
Franchise or license agreement with the non-resident franchisee, IP registration records abroad, and evidence of exclusive overseas use of the licensed rights.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and ANA cross-check zero-rated declarations against customs export records, shipping manifests, bank remittance certificates, and the franchisee’s foreign operating registrations; the franchise contract and intercompany pricing are scrutinized for artificial splitting of Panamanian-source and foreign-source service income. If the zero-rating is disallowed, the exporter must pay the unpaid 7% ITBMS on gross export value, plus statutory surcharges, monthly interest on arrears, and — where the omission is deemed fraudulent — fines ranging from 100% to 200% of the evaded tax, suspension or cancellation of the taxpayer’s e-invoicing authorization and RUC, joint and several liability of directors and resident agents, and criminal prosecution for documentary forgery and tax fraud under the Panamanian Criminal Code, which carries imprisonment sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) is the bank and AML/CFT supervisor; Banco Nacional de Panamá is the Republic's fiscal agent and settlement bank. Panama has no central bank with exchange-control powers and no foreign-exchange administration; the US dollar is legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system with no foreign-exchange control regime. Capital and current account transactions are fully convertible; there are no Panamanian exchange licences, no approval registrations for foreign direct investment, and no restrictions on dividend distributions, interest, royalties, fees, loan repayments, or liquidation proceeds. The only practical remittance hurdles are bank-level KYC/AML, OFAC/sanctions screening, proof of source of funds, and the obligation to obtain a Panamanian RUC and satisfy applicable territorial-tax and dividend-tax duties before remitting profits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama does not impose surrender, conversion, or repatriation deadlines for export receipts; no percentages or timelines are prescribed by law. Export proceeds may be retained in any currency, held at offshore banks, or converted freely. Supporting commercial invoices, bills of lading, SWIFT statements, and transfer-pricing analyses must nevertheless be retained for corporate tax and AML/CFT examination.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Panama does not issue a stand-alone e-money institution licence equivalent to the EU EMI regime. Offshore digital EMIs cannot lawfully take deposits or maintain local Panamanian settlement accounts unless they are licensed or partner with a fully licensed Panamanian bank. They are viable only as ancillary payment facilitators or white-label gateways for outbound supplier and royalty payments, never as a substitute for the primary corporate operating account held at a regulated Panamanian bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Panamanian corporate law does not universally compel directors to appear physically, but SBP-regulated banks generally require an in-person KYC interview for at least one director and each ultimate beneficial owner before account activation. Some top-tier banks permit remote videoconference onboarding for low-risk corporate clients when combined with notarized and apostilled corporate records, sworn beneficial-ownership declarations, and original documentation delivered through the registered agent; however, physical attendance at the branch or at a Panamanian consulate remains the most reliable and broadly accepted route.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex or opaque shareholder structure without a clear natural-person ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate registry excerpts; registered agent certificate; sworn statement identifying each UBO; passport copies; organizational chart; fund-flow description; sanctions and PEP screening result; declaration of sources of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of initial capital injection and capital-equity mismatch
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investor bank statements and remittance records; share-subscription agreement; board resolution approving capital increase; financial statements of the investing shareholder; tax domicile certificate; AML declaration confirming lawful source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of verifiable commercial substance of the Panamanian Sociedad Anónima
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for local representative office; payroll records; RUC and Aviso de Operación; municipal licence; utility invoices; signed master franchise and service agreements; ongoing royalty billing and settlement evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory operating-licence and food-safety gaps for a food-service business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MINSA food-handling licence or official registration; ministry inspection certificate; municipal business licence; fire-safety certificate; food-safety policy; supplier and distributor contracts; hygiene and HACCP documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payment mismatches involving franchise royalties and Chinese suppliers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master franchise and licence agreements; royalty calculation schedules; commercial invoices; customs and logistics records; confirmation of goods or services; supplier KYC and sanctions screening result; trade rationale and pricing policy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistency between tax-registration status and remittance activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RUC number; territorial-source income-tax declarations; sworn statement of tax registration and good standing; accounting records; external audit report; DGI tax-clearance certificate; legal opinion on Panamanian territorial taxation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For an equity injection, instruct a SWIFT MT103 from the investing shareholder's bank to the Panamanian bank account with remittance information stating 'Share capital contribution - Sociedad Anónima Panama [entity identifier]'. For a shareholder loan, usewith an intercompany loan agreement reference. The Panamanian bank will require source-of-funds evidence, RUC status, beneficial-ownership documentation, board resolutions, and any applicable tax-clearance opinion. Panama imposes no FX approval or registration; USD clears through the correspondent network in New York. The ordering bank must pass OFAC filters, and all SWIFT field tags must match the pre-agreed account name, account number, and SWIFT BIC to avoid rejection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Franchise royalties and trade payments are settled by SWIFT MT103/MT202 for direct USD disbursements; commercial letters of credit under UCP600 are issued through Panamanian banks using SWIFT MT700/MT720 for equipment, ingredients, and franchise supplies. Local restaurant POS receipts are settled through card-network clearing into a USD merchant operating account. For suppliers requiring RMB, the Panamanian bank's treasury desk converts USD to offshore RMB, or the Panamanian company uses a CNH hedge. Supporting contracts, invoices, and logistics documents must accompany each outbound wire for correspondent-bank compliance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/CNY forward contracts booked with a licensed Panamanian or international bank under an ISDA 2002 master agreement.
Offshore RMB non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) to fix USD/CNH conversion on RMB-denominated franchise income or supplier invoices.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps between USD and CNY or USD and HKD for synthetic cash-flow matching and long-term funding alignment.
Vanilla FX options, including USD call/CNY put and USD put/CNY call, for asymmetric protection of transaction exposures.
Currency swaps against TWD, JPY, KRW, and other regional currencies where supplier invoices or royalty streams are not USD-denominated.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First calendar quarter of each fiscal year: 2 January through 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge plus monthly legal interest; after 3 consecutive years of non-payment, the Public Registry may administratively dissolve or strike off the S.A.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta, Form 101)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March following the fiscal year end (calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-filing surcharge on tax due plus 1% monthly interest; denial of tax clearance (Paz y Salvo) and forced collection proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Confirmation (Declaración de Beneficiario Final)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI through the licensed resident agent or authorized public accountant
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary, or within 30 days after any share transfer that changes beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 10,000 under Law 23 of 2015; resident agent's license may be suspended for repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Operation Notice Renewal (Aviso de Operación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: District Municipality (Alcaldía) where the restaurant establishment operates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January or within the first two months of each calendar year, per municipal ordinance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly interest and coercive municipal collection; suspension or revocation of the municipal operating license, requiring cessation of food-franchise operations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An Sociedad Anónima must obtain an independent audit by a Panamanian licensed CPA if total assets exceed USD 1,000,000 or gross annual revenue exceeds USD 3,000,000; smaller entities may submit management-prepared financial statements or rely on the statutory exemption.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama for large entities; IFRS for SMEs for small and medium-sized companies; records must be maintained in Spanish with supporting documentation in convertible balboas/USD.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent must issue an annual UBO declaration to the S.A. before the incorporation anniversary; the ultimate natural-person owners or controlling officers must confirm, in writing, the current ownership and control chain. Any share transfer generating a new UBO must be reported to the DGI UBO electronic registry within 30 days, including names, domiciles, and tax identification numbers of every natural person owning 10% or more or exercising de facto control.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 per annum if audit threshold is triggered

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial income tax system: the standard Sociedad Anónima is taxable only on Panama-source income. Foreign-source income is neither taxed nor subject to remittance tax. No statutory tax holiday applies to fast-casual restaurant or franchise operations. Dividends distributed from profits already taxed at the corporate level receive a reduced withholding tax credit so that the combined burden does not exceed 25%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 101 (Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta – Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax portal (Sistema T@X, www.dgi.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end (e.g., by 31 March for a 31 December year-end).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyente of the Panamanian S.A., including the check digit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the S.A.'s Panamanian RUC; do not enter the foreign shareholder's tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable year covered by the return, stated as YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the S.A.'s fiscal year; for a newly incorporated entity, report a short period if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income derived from Panama-source business activities, including dining sales, delivery fees, and franchise royalties paid by Panama-based franchisees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only income sourced in Panama is reportable. Foreign franchise royalties that lack Panamanian source sit outside the tax base under territorial taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income exempt by statute and foreign-source income not subject to Panamanian ISR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned S.A. should document foreign-source income separately; exempt amounts must be traceable in the accounting records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 – Cost of Sales and Deductible Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: food and beverage costs, employee wages, rent, utilities, franchise license fees, municipal licenses, and bank charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be attributable to Panama-source revenue. Cross-border management fees must satisfy transfer-pricing fundamentals and be supported by invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source income less allowable deductions and cost of sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute exclusively with Panama-source items. If all income is foreign-source, net taxable income is nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax determined by applying 25% to net taxable income, before advance-payment credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Panamanian income arises when there is no Panama-source profit; the entering amount is zero.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 16 – Payments a Cuenta and Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for quarterly estimated tax payments, tax withheld at source, and any tax credits available under Panamanian law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may not use foreign income-tax credits against Panamanian tax. Only Panamanian payments a cuenta and legal credits are allowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance of annual tax: any remaining payment due with the return or a recoverable balance.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the final balance from a Panamanian bank account to the DGI collection account; identify the S.A.'s RUC in all wire transfers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge of 5% per month or fraction of the final tax due, capped at 50% of the tax, plus default interest of 1% per month. Administrative fines range from US$100 to US$500 per omission; fraudulent non-filing may result in criminal tax-evasion penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: DGI e-Tax quarterly estimated tax payment voucher (Pago a Cuenta / Declaración Informativa Trimestral) on Sistema T@X.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the end of each quarter: 15 April, 15 June, 15 September, and 15 December.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly fiscal period to which the advance payment applies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tie payments to the S.A.'s fiscal year; use the RUC as the payment reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated taxable income for the annual period, calculated in accordance with the previous year's return or current-year projection.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute the estimated base using only Panama-source profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly installment: one-quarter of the estimated annual ISR, less prior installments, according to DGI rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No submission is required for a zero-tax estimate if no Panama-source profit is expected.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to make quarterly pago a cuenta obligations exposes the S.A. to default interest of 1% per month plus recalculation of advance payments based on final ISR.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed from profits not previously subject to Panamanian ISR; 5% on dividends paid from Panama-source profits already taxed at the corporate level. No distinction is made between resident and non-resident shareholders for the withholding itself.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's double-tax-treaty (DTA) network is limited. Where a DTA with the shareholder's residence state is in force, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from its home tax authority, file a written DTA relief application with the DGI, and obtain approval before the distribution. The paying S.A. retains the approved application and TRC in its transfer-pricing and tax files and applies the treaty rate on dividends, royalties, or interest only from the date of DGI approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 12.5% withholding on cross-border IP royalties; DTA rates generally 10% where applicable. Interest: statutory 6% withholding on cross-border related-party debt, with DTA rates typically 5% to 10%; interest paid to recognized foreign banks may be exempt under Panamanian law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: US$2,000,000 (B/.2,000,000) in aggregate related-party transactions per fiscal year triggers mandatory documentation obligations, including a Local File and an annual transfer pricing information return (Formulario 159). A Master File may additionally be required when the group exceeds the DGI volume thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 52 of 2016, as amended by Executive Decree 239 of 2019) apply to entities undertaking relevant activities. Franchise licensing and intellectual-property-holding activity are treated as relevant activities. The Panamanian S.A. earning franchise royalties must demonstrate minimum economic substance in Panama, including local premises, qualified employees, and core decision-making exercised in Panama, proportionate to the income derived. A mere holding or licensing shell without substance is exposed to substantial fines and recharacterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentional understatement of Panama-source restaurant revenue, fabrication of expense invoices, suppression of cash sales, or concealed POS records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties under the Panamanian Criminal Code: imprisonment from 2 to 5 years and a fine of up to 10 times the evaded tax, plus civil re-assessment, default interest at 1% per month, and 50% surcharge.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt. Panama courts may pierce the corporate veil, impose travel bans, freeze personal assets, and order preventive detention in egregious cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Panamanian S.A. as a nominee structure without economic substance, solely to hold franchise income, accumulate profits for non-resident principals, or misrepresent beneficial control.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The DGI may disregard the corporate personality, reattribute the income to the beneficial owner, and impose fines under the transparency and beneficial-ownership rules of Law 52 of 2016. Administrative penalties can reach US$1,000,000 for repeated non-compliance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners and nominal directors face personal liability for the reattributed tax; involuntary dissolution, asset seizures, and criminal prosecution for fraud may follow when the shell is used to evade tax or launder money.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting significant cash payments from unknown walk-in customers without maintaining mandatory AML records, failing to report suspicious transactions, or using unregistered cash collection points in a food-franchise network.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 23 of 2015, administrative fines for AML failures may range from US$50,000 to US$10,000,000 depending on sector and severity, plus criminal conviction for money laundering, carrying up to 10 years' imprisonment and asset forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and legal representatives who knowingly permit undocumented cash flows or conceal beneficial ownership are personally liable. Panama prosecutes individuals independently of the corporation, and travel bans are routinely issued pending trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Franchisor and IP-licensing S.A. deriving royalties from foreign franchisees while lacking physical premises, staff, and decision-making in Panama, or failing to file the annual economic substance report.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of Economic Substance Regulations expose the S.A. to fines from US$50,000 to US$1,000,000, late-filing penalties of US$500 per month per report, and disqualification from holding a clear tax-payer status certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly cause the S.A. to maintain artificial structures may be fined individually, removed from office, and barred from serving as directors in Panama. In combination with tax evasion, the corporate veil is pierced and director assets are reachable.
